findings.description: Icon-only mobile close button has no accessible label. The <button> renders only an <XIcon> SVG with no aria-label and no visible text. Screen readers will announce it as an unlabelled button, making it impossible for assistive-technology users to identify its purpose.
findings.consequence: Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot identify or operate the sidebar close button on mobile.
findings.correction: Add aria-label="Close navigation" to the button element, matching the pattern already used on the hamburger button in PlatformHeader.jsx line 21.
